tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm chalk-white in light; floodlit-night green-black in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table rows, the review side panel.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind video, input backgrounds, the app sidebar.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and secondary-button borders. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and pitch-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, metadata, timestamps, table headers. On every surface.

tokens.name: pitch
tokens.usage: Brand green. Primary buttons, active nav, links, selected states, confirmed events. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: on-pitch
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pitch fill. Never literal white in dark: the dark pitch is light.

tokens.name: pitch-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fills: selected rows, active chips, success backgrounds. ink or pitch text on it.

tokens.name: floodlight
tokens.usage: Accent. The one hot colour: highlights, the 'new' dot, focus of attention in charts, the cover. A fill only, never text.

tokens.name: on-floodlight
tokens.usage: Text on a floodlight fill, in both themes.

tokens.name: home
tokens.usage: Home side in match views (track outlines, lineup column, event dots). Always paired with an H marker or the team name.

tokens.name: away
tokens.usage: Away side in match views. Always paired with an A marker or the team name. Blue and orange are safe for red-green colour blindness.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Pending review, low confidence, footage expiring soon. Text-safe on every surface and on warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning chips and the expiry banner.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rejected events, withdrawn consent, destructive actions, errors. Text-safe on every surface and on danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of danger chips and error banners.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. At least 6:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: turf
tokens.usage: Pitch fill in heatmaps, average-position maps and the pitch calibration view.

tokens.name: chalk
tokens.usage: Pitch markings drawn over turf, 1.5px.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 1 (least time). Heat steps run turf → floodlight → orange; used only on turf.

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 2.

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 3.

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 4.

tokens.name: heat-5
tokens.usage: Heatmap step 5 (most time).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Player name on the profile hero. One per page.

styles.name: stat-xl
styles.usage: The number in a StatTile. Uses tabular figures.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Your match is ready for review.
styles.usage: Guardian consent pages and empty states: plain-language reading.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Names, row titles, emphasis inside body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, stat labels, table headers.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Chip and section eyebrows, all caps.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Match timestamps, confidence scores, table numbers.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; table cell vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, page gutter on phones (375px).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards; page gutter on tablet.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Hero spacing on profile and marketing pages.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, inputs, table rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, video player.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Hero panels, modals, the cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Confidence meters, toggles and avatar circles only.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and modals only. Cards use a line border, not a shadow.
